description.text: Main Courses: Western Economics, International Economics, Econometrics,Political Economics, Introduction to World Economy, International Trade Theory and Practice, International Finance, International Settlement, Monetary Banking, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor's Degree in Economics Teaching aim : The teaching aim of course is to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Hunan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate.
